projects.title: Stock AI - Tran Gia Huy
projects.subtitle: A comprehensive platform for stock analysis and personalized investment strategies in the Vietnamese stock market, integrated with Gemini AI to simulate expert analytical thinking. (Includes 7-Day Free Trial)
projects.subject: Python, PySide6, AI
projects.businessGoal:
Developed based on real-world research and active trading in the Vietnamese stock market to translate qualitative investment thinking into a systematic, rule-based decision support system.

Enables personalization of screening criteria and stock evaluations matching individual investment styles, while combining technical analysis, cash flow tracking, and macroeconomic trends to identify high-probability opportunities.

Actively utilized by retail investors and stockbrokers as a daily research, screening, and decision-support tool.
projects.challenges:
The primary challenge was codifying qualitative, multi-dimensional investment knowledge into systematic, programmable rules.

Beyond processing large-scale historical market data, the system simulates complex analysis including cash flow behavior, fundamental enterprise health, market cycles, and macroeconomic variables.

Designed not merely to aggregate news, but to enable the AI to analyze underlying causes of market shifts and project potential impacts on related sectors and equities.
projects.learnings:
Architected as a high-performance Python desktop application using PySide6 and Google Gemini AI, leveraging multi-threading (QThread) to handle heavy analytics without blocking the UI.

Built a highly flexible framework allowing users to extend and refine AI guidelines based on personal trading preferences, aligning the AI closer to the user's decision-making style.

Acquired deep cross-functional expertise bridging financial research, software systems engineering, and generative AI application design.
